name: Santa Eulàlia de Riuprimer (Spain)
description: Black field with a red saltire and a white wavy fess of five crests over all at the centre.
history: The flag was approved on 28 April 2000 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, black, with a red saltire 1/6 of the height and a white wavy fess of five crests of the same thickness superimposed at the centre.

features.role: wavy fess of five crests, 1/6 of the height
